name: Qingdao Gon Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Qingdao Gon Technology Co., Ltd., founded in 2000 and based in Qingdao, China, specializes in the research, development, production, and sale of advanced plastic materials and components. Their product portfolio includes a variety of modified plastic particles, such as glass fiber reinforced polypropylene (PP), acrylonitrile styrene (AS), and acrylonitrile butadiene styrene (ABS), as well as standard PP and flame-retardant polycarbonate/ABS blends. The company also produces functional plastic plates and a range of finished modified plastic products, including axial flow and centrifugal fans, panels for air conditioners, TV rear covers, and various parts for washing machines and air conditioning units. These specialized materials and products find extensive application across numerous sectors, including home appliances, automotive, electronics, electrical appliances, machinery, and construction.
